platform: KUPS 90.1 The Sound Public Artist Submission Form Route
manual_review_reason: KUPS explicitly invites music submissions through its public contact form and publishes current Electronic, Specialty, Alternative and other Music Director addresses plus a postal route. The form does not publish audio-upload, download-link, attachment, metadata, clean-edit or rights-confirmation rules, so a human must choose one authorized route, inspect the live form for any dynamic challenge, prepare a concise rights-cleared pitch and avoid duplicate delivery.

platform: WUTK 90.3 The Rock Direct MP3 Email and Physical Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WUTK explicitly accepts MP3 tracks at wutkmusic@gmail.com or music by mail and requires a track list, artist name and band contact information. A human must select suitable tracks, verify file names and tags, confirm rights and clean-edit status, keep attachments within normal mailbox limits and send the editorial submission manually.

platform: KBVR-FM 88.7 Performer and Promoter Music Director Route
manual_review_reason: KBVR explicitly directs promoters and performers to its Music Director and publishes a station address. The same page also contains a separate listener-request form with a validation field and CAPTCHA; that form is not the artist submission route and must not be automated or repurposed. A human must use only the official Music Director contact link, confirm accepted formats and delivery rules, and handle any physical or digital delivery manually.

platform: KCPR 91.3 FM Music and Programming Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
manual_review_reason: KCPR publishes a dedicated Music and Programming contact and current Programming and Music Director plus a mailing address, but the current site does not publish accepted formats, attachment or download-link rules, release windows or an unsolicited-media policy. A human must first send a limited routing inquiry through the official protected contact without audio attachments or track links and wait for delivery instructions.

platform: WRFL 88.1 FM Appropriate-Director Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
manual_review_reason: WRFL instructs visitors to contact the appropriate director and publishes contact@wrfl.fm for cases where the correct recipient is unknown, together with mailing and physical addresses. The current page does not identify a specific public music-submission recipient or delivery requirements, so a human must send only a concise routing inquiry without audio, download links or attachments and wait for authorization.
